Explain the example for add a second route

blocks.text: A folder with its own page.tsx makes a route. The folder name becomes part of the web address.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

items: The books folder supplies the `/books` address segment.
`page.tsx` exports the component rendered at that address.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A folder alone is not a visible page. Add a page.tsx file with a component.
